public_rationale: The technical record supports edge cases remaining a central challenge. The chronology is overstated on the ordinary reading of recognition: Waymo documented a dedicated program for rare situations in an account describing September 2015. That does not establish when the whole industry appreciated the full difficulty, or accepted the narrower argument against enumeration.
limitations: The result depends on reading 'woken up' as substantive recognition, rather than an unspecified later change in conviction.
One company's earlier work cannot establish an industry-wide consensus.

criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous technical evidence identifies unusual situations as a central reliability challenge, and historical records place substantive industry recognition only within the few years preceding the post.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous evidence shows edge cases were no longer a central reliability challenge, or substantially earlier industry records demonstrate recognition and sustained work on that challenge.
